title: Roadstorm shared schema vocabulary
description: Definitions shared by Roadstorm versioned resource, fixture, reference and scenario files. Version 1.0.0 is defined at M0.9. Later contract changes require a new schema_version recorded with a decision; the files in this directory are text contracts, not runtime code.

stable_id.description: Stable semantic ID. Display names may change; IDs must not.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 over canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8) of the file with the content_hash member removed.

path.description: Dotted path to the unfixed value or absent section.

blocking.description: true when dependent work must not freeze the value.

until.description: Milestone or decision that resolves the unknown, when one is known.

source_contract.description: Design/benchmark document this artifact was derived from.

acceptance_metric.description: One documented acceptance target or reporting requirement. Which bound members are legal depends on the comparator, enforced by the allOf rules below: threshold comparators (eq, lte, gte, lt, gt) require a numeric value and no range bounds; range/ratio_range require value_min and value_max and no value; report carries no bound at all. This mirrors schemas/handling/validate_fixtures.py so a metric cannot satisfy one contract and violate the other. The handling validator additionally requires the value to be numeric for threshold comparators; this schema deliberately leaves value untyped for other contracts' comparators over non-numeric quantities.

comparator.description: report means measure and publish without declaring a pass/fail gate yet.
